## About
Chau and Niem came to Marin from Vietnam, started out at a local Marin shop, and went to the College of Marin to learn their craft. Later they pooled the family money, bought the shop in San Rafael and renamed it. They're still there today and active in the community.
We work on foreign and domestic cars, and no job is too small or too big. Our customers have given us a 5 star rating across 30 Google reviews, and some of them have been bringing their cars to us for years.

## Services
- Foreign and domestic auto repair: Repair work on both foreign and domestic cars for drivers around Marin.
- Complete servicing: Mechanical, electrical, A/C, computer diagnostics and specialty repairs.
- Jobs big and small: From quick fixes to major work, bring it in and we'll take a look.

## FAQ
Q: Do I need an appointment?
A: Yes, please call us at (415) 454-6899 to set up an appointment.

Q: When are you open?
A: We open at 8 AM, Monday through Friday.

Q: Where is the shop?
A: We're at 43 Tiburon Street in San Rafael, off the Francisco Blvd. E exit.

I’ve brought him VWs, Subarus - basically any car that dealership service departments have tried to hold for ransom. Compared to their sub-standard, over-priced “care,” Chau is a magician. A wizard. A mechanical therapist. The man routinely fixes things in minutes, waves his hand, and sends me off on my merry way without charging me a dime. In return, I attempt to restock his wine cellar… although I’m pretty sure he’s a connoisseur and I’m just the amateur who brings him “grape-based beverages.”

He’s an excellent mechanic with a can-do attitude, the kind of person who inspires both trust and mild suspicion that he might secretly be a superhero.

The only downside? He’s so good and so beloved that sometimes I have to wait a couple of days to get into his shop. But honestly - totally worth it. My cars are happier than I am after a three-day weekend.

Highly recommend." (Dhruv Ratra, 5/5)
